subject: Missed demo — quick reschedule or async walkthrough?
messages:
From: Kayla Nguyen <kayla@chartlogic.co>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-01-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Booked: Redwood demo (ChartLogic)

Hi Jordan,

I signed up for the self-serve trial earlier and booked a 30-min demo for Jan 9 at 10:00 PT so my team can see inference costs and latency on our datasets. Details were pretty light in the booking form — I work on data infra at ChartLogic (I copied Tom on future threads).

Can you confirm an agenda and whether we should share any sample data ahead of time? Also, do you have a short one-pager on how Dedicated differs from hosted for compliance?

Thanks,
Kayla Nguyen
Data Infrastructure Manager | ChartLogic
Kayla: 415-555-0187

Attachment(s): none
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Kayla Nguyen <kayla@chartlogic.co>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@chartlogic.co>
Date: 2029-01-05T10:01:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Booked: Redwood demo (ChartLogic)

Thanks for booking, Kayla — excited to connect. Agenda I suggest:
- 10m: onboarding & goals (what workload you’ll serve)
- 10m: live demo (hosted + dedicated comparison)
- 10m: Q&A + next steps (pricing/POCs)

If you can drop a short note on expected QPS and any compliance constraints (SOC2/KMS requirement), that’ll help me tailor the demo. I attached a quick one-pager on Hosted vs Dedicated.

If that slot still works, great — otherwise let me know and we’ll reschedule.

—
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | (650) 555-0124
Attachment(s): redwood-one-pager.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Kayla Nguyen <kayla@chartlogic.co>
Date: 2029-01-09T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Booked: Redwood demo (ChartLogic)

Hi Kayla — I joined the call at 10:00 but it looks like you weren’t on. No worries — things come up.

Would you prefer: 
1) A short 15–20 minute reconvene later this week (I can open a few windows), or
2) A quick async walkthrough: I record a 10–12 minute session showing your two most common flows and share a timestamped recording + notes.

If option 1, here are two available times: Jan 10 11:00 PT or Jan 11 09:30 PT. If neither work, drop a couple slots and I’ll coordinate.

If you want to loop someone else who handles procurement, happy to include them.

—
Jordan
From: Kayla Nguyen <kayla@chartlogic.co>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@chartlogic.co>
Date: 2029-01-09T11:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Booked: Redwood demo (ChartLogic)

> Hi Kayla — I joined the call at 10:00 but it looks like you weren’t on. No worries — things come up.

> Would you prefer: 
> 1) A short 15–20 minute reconvene later this week (I can open a few windows), or
> 2) A quick async walkthrough: I record a 10–12 minute session showing your two most common flows and share a timestamped recording + notes.

Ah — apologies, we ran into an internal incident that pulled my team away last-minute. We can do option 1 — Jan 11 at 09:30 PT works for me and Tom. If you can send an invite, great.

Also — we likely want to touch on data locality and whether Redwood Private would be needed; Tom will have a couple of procurement questions on retention and KMS.

Thanks for the quick follow-up.
Kayla
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Kayla Nguyen <kayla@chartlogic.co>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-01-10T09:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Missed demo — quick reschedule or async walkthrough?

Hi Kayla — welcome back, and thanks for the update. Jordan’s confirmed Jan 11 at 09:30 PT and I just dropped a 15-minute invite so you have a compact window (calendar link below).

If you’d prefer to keep it short, I’ll have Jordan focus on latency/cost comparisons and I’ll follow with a procurement checklist you can share internally. If you have any documents you want us to reference ahead of the call, upload to this Drive link and we’ll review.

If Jan 11 ends up being tight, we can do an async alternative (Jordan records + I capture procurement notes) — whichever is easier.

Calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/s/jordan/15min
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_redwood-demo-assets

Cheers,

SDR — Redwood Inference

If you want, I can introduce our solutions architect for a deeper security conversation.
